case_index_space.scheme: global case index; batch n covers [n*1000, (n+1)*1000)
case_index_space.seeding: each case seeded from its own global index via splitmix64(base_seed, index)
case_index_space.non_overlap_proof: index ranges are disjoint by construction; no index is drawn twice, so no case can be double-counted across batches
case_index_space.reproducibility: any failing case is reproducible alone from its index, without replaying its batch

counting_rules.note: batches count together only while the materially relevant implementation and environment are compatible

per_case_coverage: full 5.4 choreography over the real vendored DOM FFI
rodada 0A commit/reveal with all commitments before any reveal
assert verification through range_proof_verify_with_extra_commit with the raw 96-byte capsule
randomized participants, value (including 0 and MAX_PROVABLE_VALUE edges), blinding shares and capsule bytes

batches.command: DSC_F4_SOAK_CASES=1000 DSC_F4_SOAK_BATCH=0 cargo test -p dom-adaptor --test collaborative_bp_soak -- --ignored --nocapture
batches.harness_repo: sorenplanck/dom-protocol (feature line; harness cannot compile here until the pin advances)

cumulative.note: The harness prints DSC_F4_REQUIREMENT=SATISFIED against its local threshold of 1000, which is the ratified local integration gate. That is NOT the closure gate. The closure gate needs 10000 unique passing cases across disjoint index ranges and stays NOT_SATISFIED.

policy: The 10000-case closure gate is NOT complete until this manifest proves 10000 unique passing cases. Remaining batches are a release/closure evidence task and must not block ordinary development.
